item.description: GUWAHATI: Hatigaon Police on Wednesday, January 28, arrested three individuals for impersonating Income Tax officers and cheating two youths of ₹64,000, police said. item.title: Assam Opposition Leader Alleges Special Revision of Electoral Rolls Targets Miya Community, Approaches SC
item.description: GUWAHATI: Debabrata Saikia, Leader of Opposition in the Assam Legislative Assembly, has filed a plea before the Chief Justice of India on January 28, 2026, seeking suo motu cognisance of alleged irregularities in the ongoing Special Revision of electoral rolls in Assam. The petition claims that the process is being deliberately misused to target a specific community, potentially resulting in large-scale voter disenfranchisement. item.title: “No Warning, No Planning”: Chandmari Flyover Chaos Exposes How Authorities Ignore Their Own Advisory to Meet Deadlines
item.description: GUWAHATI: January 30, Friday morning, brought Guwahati to a crawl. Rajgarh, Chandmari, Anuradha and the GNB road witnessed hours of traffic chaos, confusion and mounting public anger after authorities abruptly shut both sides of the Chandmari Flyover, completely overturning an earlier traffic advisory and leaving commuters stranded with no warning and almost no traffic management on the ground.
